title: How long is a minute?
_map: How long is a minute? (Y1–2). Big idea: comparing durations. Creative: guess what he can do in one minute (jumps, blocks placed), then test it.
_story: Steve says it can build a whole barn in one minute. Ismaeel guesses what he can do in a minute, then tests it for real with a grown-up timing, and finds out a minute is longer than it sounds.
_stepChain: a minute (farm-clock) → seconds: 60 in a minute → some things take seconds, some minutes, some hours → guess, then test → compare

talk.ask: How many jumps could you do in one minute? Was it more or less than you guessed?
talk.goodAnswer: his real number, and whether it was more or less than his guess.

talk.ask: What takes about a second? About a minute? About an hour?
talk.goodAnswer: a clap; brushing teeth is a couple of minutes; a long walk or a film is about an hour or more.

handsOn: With a grown-up timing one minute: how many times can you jump? How many Lego bricks can you stack? Guess first, then test!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: I bet I can build a whole barn in one minute! Easy.
A minute is made of 60 tiny bits of time called seconds. One second is about as long as saying: one farm-yard. Say it with me: one farm-yard, two farm-yard, three farm-yard.
Some things take seconds, some take minutes, and some take hours.

question.prompt: How long does building a real barn take?
question.reveal: Many hours, even days! A minute is enough to stack a few blocks, not to build a barn.

question.prompt: How many jumps can you do in one minute?
question.reveal: Let's find out! Ask a grown-up to time one minute while you jump and count. Many people can do about 50 to 80. A minute is longer than it sounds!

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: OK, maybe I can't build a barn in a minute. But I could stack about 20 blocks! What can you do in a minute? Go and test it!

rule.ask: Can you say how many seconds are in a minute? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: 60 seconds make one minute. Guess how long something takes, then test it to find out.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: how many minutes in an hour?
bonus.reveal: 60 minutes, and 60 seconds in each minute.
